frames.narration: Alright, everyone. This is the briefing for Period eleven, week one, District eight. Thirty-eight hours across nineteen sets, and twelve of those hours belong to one Asian Foods set that has opinions. After this week come two blackout weeks, so let's finish strong. Checkpoints along the way, and they count.

frames.title: This Week at a Glance
frames.narration: Here is the week on one screen. Grocery carries six sets, Health Beauty Care carries four, the produce department carries two, meat carries three, and Natural Foods carries four. Traditional Asian is the big one at twelve hours, then Baked Bread at six. Eight sets run cold, and every cold set has a twenty-minute limit on product out of the case.

frames.narration: Traditional Asian is the heavy lift, twelve hours, and the test store confirms it. Here is your action item for this week. The item lookup drops the last digit of the U-P-C, so valid items can look like they are not on the set. The test store found about half a dozen. Verify before you set anything aside. The core runs about twice the Kroger size. The first two or three bays are heavy glass bottles with private label expanding, and most of that product shifts side to side, so move it carefully. Tofu moves to the top, and curry soup mixes come down into the snack area. Snacks and drinks are mostly vertical, with some drinks shifting left. The noodle section has the biggest change and the most new items, and it is the easiest part to set. The test also pulled three banana boxes of out-of-date product on a twenty-eight-foot set. Pull anything expired, label it, box it, and give it to the store. Refrigerated Asian strips at twenty-three and Refrigerated Kosher strips at six five eight get recorded under Asian.

frames.narration: Frozen Bread Dough is two hours and runs cold. Kroger private label and Texas Toast swap places, with Kroger taking the lead. All the rolls come up off the bottom, Pillsbury Grands move down, and the frozen noodles move vertically until they are fully blocked in the last door. Baked Bread is six hours. New Wonder Breakfast items come in, plus one Nature's Own Private Collection Artisan item, and the Wonder mainstream and bun items move to eye level. Natural Foods Bread strips get recorded under Baked Bread. Natural Foods Frozen Bread is one hour of new items, cold, and its frozen inline strips get recorded under it.

With that space open, Flirt, Starbucks, Gorgie, Liquid Death, and Lotus may move up to the top two shelves, and Bloom and Alani pick up room. Bagels and Cream Cheese is one hour and runs cold. Philadelphia Cranberry Orange spread comes in, and corrected S-R-P sizes on the Kroger cream cheese bars and two-pack move some product and facings. Pasta Sauce and Paper Housewares are one hour each of new items. Store four five nine gets Natural Foods Dry Noodle strips, and those get recorded under Pasta Sauce.

Period twelve, week one, is nineteen hours, and then weeks two and three of Period twelve are blackout again.

The produce sets go first, and the salad cards travel with the product. Shifts and payroll are done by Saturday. Twenty-three and thirty-one, watch your tracking. Then two weeks of blackout, which you will notice is not the same thing as two weeks of nothing. That is the briefing. The quiz is next.
